label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: Keyboard focus starts in a newsletter sign-up popup that I did not ask for, with its email field pre-filled as the first stop and a subscribe checkbox already ticked, so I had to untick it and tab through terms, privacy, Sign Up and Log in links to reach the close button.
The popup close button is read only as close modal with an icon and sits last in the popup after the Sign Up and Log in buttons, so declining takes about 8 Tab presses.

After the popup closed, Tab repeatedly landed on unnamed embedded frames (reported as nothing focused or an embedded payment field), a keyboard trap-like dead stop where focus appeared to go nowhere and I could not tell where I was.

None of the visible Shop Now buttons, category names (Power Banks, Chargers and so on), product Learn More links or the My Cart item can be reached with Tab. The only focusable things on the page are the brand link, six footer policy links, Cookies Settings and one unnamed icon button, so a keyboard user cannot choose or add a product at all.

The cookie banner is only reachable at the very end of the Tab order and offers just Cookies Settings, with no Reject or Accept button I could find; and one icon button has no accessible name at all, pressing Enter on it showed no visible change and dropped focus back to the top of the page.
